description: Nombre de souscripteurs Véligo Location par commune is a dataset listed in Île-de-France Mobilités open data, an open data portal of a public transport authority, published or maintained by Île-de-France Mobilités. Ce jeu de données indique le nombre de souscripteurs Véligo Location: VAE Classique et Cargo par commune. Mise à jour du 29 Avril 2025. Coverage: France (network area of the operator or portal owner). The portal files it under Fréquentation & Statistiques, Vélos & Nouvelles mobilités. Its keywords are Vélo, Location, Collectivité. The portal shows 2026-01-14 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte v2.0 (Etalab) (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/wp-content/uploads/2017/04/ETALAB-Licence-Ouverte-v2.0.pdf). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support network planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-idfm-open-data-portal.
